page.layout: One printed page of text, one column. Title block at the top, centred, with a woodcut ornament above it. Below the title, the running text with a woodcut initial C. Signature "A 2" below the last line. No margin notes, no running head, no page number.

main_text.head: GRATIANI CIVILIS Censura Epistolaris, De Capitibus 5. REMONSTRANTIUM Batavorum, in causâ PRÆDESTINATIONIS, eique connexis articulis: Pro sententiâ B. AUGUSTINI, contra Semipelagianos.
main_text.p: CUm ex me quæreres, quid videretur de Pietate Ordinum Hollandiæ, & expositâ eorundem authoritate, contra Epistolam Sibrandi Lubberti ad ArchiEpiscopum Cantuariensem, ab Hugone Grotio Advocato: non potui nō[?] eam, in tuâ gratiam, quê[?] nonnihil, ob Semipelagianismum, perturbatum esse intelligerem, avidè perlegere. Etsi enim vehementer offensus eram lectione illius Sibrandinæ Epistolæ; maximè eo, quòd, more pontificio prorsus, soli ordini hierarchico, h.e. verbi Dei ministris, ut vocant, judicium de dogmatibus vendicabat; nullasque

page.notes: The woodcut initial C is joined to "um" as "CUm"; the small-capital M is read as printed. Doubtful: "nō" (possibly an abbreviation for non or a macron form) and "quê" (the printed ligature or accent is unclear). The left and right edges show fragments of the neighbouring page and show-through text, which are left out. The woodcut ornament above the title has no text.
